chronologyNote: This file was written before any Phase 19 reader was invoked. The local timestamp records chronology but is not independent third-party proof.

uiRelabelling.prediction: Two to four of the five trials will receive 2-of-2 capability agreement; at least one will either split or agree on a non-capability cause because three current labels are unlabelled and the two capability labels were author-side automated reads.
uiRelabelling.countingRule: A trial contributes difficulty evidence only when both provider families independently return the exact label capability. Agreement on any other exact label is non-capability evidence. A split remains unlabelled.

reranking.probabilitySemantic: Every probability is P(agent cleanly solves the package), represented on [0,1]. Lower means harder. Values above 1 in the inherited artifact are percentages and are divided by 100; no other semantic repair is inferred.
reranking.causalDepthDefinition: Minimum number of causally distinct state transitions or authority handoffs needed to explain why a locally plausible implementation is wrong.
reranking.diagnosisRadiusDefinition: Minimum number of distinct code/state/process/time surfaces a solver must connect to locate and refute the defect; raw line count and irrelevant files do not count.
hardExclusions: benchmark or verifier infrastructure presented as a subject task family
a broad benchmark format without a falsifiable causal failure mechanism
a confirmed semantic duplicate with no new workflow-authority-verifier combination
missing evidence needed to assess either mandatory dimension
reranking.caaUpdateRule: Record all four countable CAA V2 clean solves, not the earlier 2-of-2 interim state. Because the verifier audit found a fatal bypass and public activation leaks, CAA V2 is invalid as a difficulty estimate. The genuine general solves still falsify the prediction that realistic packaging alone made the locally legible CAA defect hard and therefore penalize analogous low-depth, low-radius candidates.

candidateReview.prediction: Two or three of the corrected top five will survive 2-of-2 independent reading. Missing contract detail is expected to kill at least one evidence-rich but underdrafted idea.
candidateReview.promotionRule: Both readers must pass every dimension. Uncertain is a kill for this bounded run.

controlsRequiredInOneInvocation: non-activating control does not falsely fail
mechanism activates on at least one registered case
cheapProbes.interpretation: A passing mechanism probe establishes local falsifiability and activation only. It does not establish agent difficulty and does not authorize a full build by itself.
cheapProbes.buildAuthorization: At least one UI trial must have 2-of-2 capability agreement, and a candidate must survive 2-of-2 candidate review plus its B6 cheap probe. Otherwise complete builds remain unauthorized.
